summary: Adds Min/Max to _known_functions mapping to min/max builtins in PythonCodePrinter, directly resolving the reported issue via the same established pattern used for Abs. The change is minimal, correct for the standard Python printer, and consistent with existing conventions.

issues.description: Python's builtin min/max don't behave identically to Min/Max for all inputs (e.g., NaN handling, symbolic/unorderable args), and subclasses like NumPyPrinter inheriting this mapping would get elementwise-incorrect min/max instead of numpy.minimum/maximum; however this mirrors the pre-existing Abs precedent and isn't a regression introduced uniquely by this diff.
